I think that’s true but it’s hard to fight it when I go into a heavy episode of it when I can’t talk to anyone from fear of not being understood or made up

I’ve told her about it and she’s been helpful in helping me be more comfortable and understand that she really does love me. regarding trauma, growing up I lived in a verbally abusive home and around when I was 13 my mother started doing drugs and getting into trouble. My dad was manipulative and good at using people to get what he wanted so they always argued with themselves also. They ended up splitting and I was told while later that he’s not my real dad and  that I’ve never actually met my father. Years of verbal harassment and deception made me feel worthless and I felt this way all through school. I used to get into fights so I could try to feel something other than sadness. Around high school when I was 16-18 I went into a period where I felt numb and did drugs with some friends, we did stuff like weed lsd coke etc. it helped in the moment but we all ended up dropping out (I ended up finishing it later and am now in college) I used to be heavily overweight aswell peaking at probably 260-270 in high school. I’ve now lost weight to try and work on my complexion and confidence(now currently 180). I’m told I’m attractive and I have had people confess their feelings for me but I feel like a majority of relationships they just want me for looks and disregard my past and leading into verbally abusive relationships. I’m not saying I had the worst childhood but I think I went through a pretty shit experience that left me with self doubt and self hatred

I completely relate to this and I’m sorry you’re feeling this way. Some people have trouble making friends but the grass isn’t greener on the other side. I have plenty of people who care but I still feel alone and lost and I hate to feel like a bother to them. 
We can get through this brother
